question_text: Does the agreement specify a standard, commercially acceptable governing law jurisdiction (e.g., Delaware, New York, England & Wales, or California) without unusual foreign or unfriendly forums?
plain_language_summary: Ensures dispute resolution occurs in a predictable, commercially sophisticated legal jurisdiction.
pass_rule: {"type": "choice", "pass_values": ["Delaware", "New York", "California", "Standard US Commercial Law"], "fail_values": ["Unfriendly Foreign Jurisdiction", "Undisclosed"]}

question_text: Does the contract contain an aggregate liability cap limited to 12 months of fees paid/payable (or a defined reasonable monetary maximum) for general contract claims?
plain_language_summary: Protects the company against unlimited exposure by capping general contractual liability at annual contract value.

question_text: Are uncapped liability carve-outs strictly limited to customary exclusions (willful misconduct, gross negligence, confidentiality breaches, and IP indemnification), rather than broad operational performance breaches?
plain_language_summary: Ensures that exceptions to the liability cap do not inadvertently uncap ordinary service-level or contract breaches.

question_text: Can the customer or counterparty terminate the contract for convenience prior to natural contract expiration without paying early termination fees or remaining committed contract value?
plain_language_summary: Prevents counterparties from cancelling contracted revenue on short notice without economic protection.

question_text: Does the anti-assignment clause contain an express exception permitting assignment without counterparty consent in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets?
plain_language_summary: Ensures an M&A transaction or change-of-control financing can close without requiring counterparty consent.

question_text: Are counterparty audit rights restricted to once per annual period, during standard business hours, upon at least 15–30 days prior written notice, and at counterparty's sole expense (unless material discrepancy is found)?
plain_language_summary: Prevents intrusive, frequent, or unannounced commercial audits of company books and facilities.

question_text: Is the software or product license grant clearly defined as non-exclusive, revocable upon uncured material breach, and strictly limited to customer's internal business purposes?
plain_language_summary: Prevents customers from commercially exploiting, sublicensing, or claiming broad rights in licensed technology.

question_text: Does the contract confirm that the vendor/provider retains sole ownership of all pre-existing IP, platform technology, modifications, and underlying software code, without assigning work product IP to the customer?
plain_language_summary: Prevents counterparty claims that custom configurations, deliverables, or integrations belong to the customer as work made for hire.

question_text: Does the contract impose non-compete covenants or restrictive covenants prohibiting the company from selling to other clients in the same industry or vertical?
plain_language_summary: Preserves the company's freedom to sell products and services across its total addressable market without restraint.

question_text: Does the contract grant exclusive commercial, territory, product, or distribution rights to the counterparty?
plain_language_summary: Ensures the business is not legally locked out of lucrative distribution channels or customer segments.

question_text: Does the agreement provide for automatic renewal terms (e.g. 12-month successive extensions) unless written notice of non-renewal is provided in advance?
plain_language_summary: Secures baseline recurring revenue retention and predictable multi-year contract renewals.

question_text: Is the required notice window to prevent automatic renewal reasonable (30 to 60 days before term end, rather than onerous 90+ days or surprise windows)?
plain_language_summary: Prevents accidental contract lock-in or customer termination surprises due to unbalanced notice windows.

question_text: Are required commercial insurance minimum coverage levels (cyber, general liability, E&O) within standard commercially insurable limits without excessive named insured obligations?
plain_language_summary: Verifies that contractual insurance covenants align with commercially viable policy limits.

question_text: Is the product or software performance warranty duration limited to a reasonable period (30–90 days from delivery or acceptance) with exclusive remedies specified (repair, replace, or refund)?
plain_language_summary: Protects against open-ended, perpetual warranty defect claims and unspecified consequential damages.

question_text: Does the contract require deposit of proprietary source code into escrow, and if so, are release conditions strictly limited to formal bankruptcy or complete cessation of business?
plain_language_summary: Ensures proprietary source code cannot be released to customers or third parties under ordinary service disputes.

question_text: Does the contract restrict the counterparty from actively soliciting or poaching key technical and management employees during and for 12 months after the contract term?
plain_language_summary: Guards key technical, engineering, and executive talent against predatory customer hiring.

question_text: Does the contract impose a Most Favored Nation (MFN) clause requiring pricing or terms to match any more favorable deal offered to third parties?
plain_language_summary: Protects pricing power and margins by avoiding restrictive commitments to match discounts given to other customers.

question_text: Does the contract contain a Change of Control provision that permits the counterparty to terminate the contract or renegotiate terms upon an acquisition of the company?
plain_language_summary: Prevents customers from disrupting business valuation or exercising termination rights upon an M&A exit.
